# Sherpa

> Non-custodial trading infrastructure for AI agents.

Portfolio context in. Policy-checked transaction intent out. User authorization remains required.

Application: https://app.runsherpa.ai/
Contact: team@runsherpa.ai

## Interface

- Capabilities: portfolio intelligence, DCA, copy trading, and multi-chain transaction preparation.
- Constraints: user-defined asset scope, size, cadence, and approval policy.
- Invariant: Sherpa does not hold keys, guarantee returns, or bypass required authorization.

## Sequence

Observe → propose → validate → prepare → authorize.

## Risk

Crypto assets and decentralized finance involve substantial risk, including loss of principal. Agent-assisted and automated strategies can lose money and may not execute as expected. Sherpa provides software and information, not investment, legal, or tax advice.
